entities.name: Kaldheim
entities.description: A Norse-inspired plane of warriors, storytelling and song, built around the World Tree and ten realms.

entities.name: World Tree
entities.description: The massive tree at the heart of Kaldheim from which ten realms hang; burned during the Phyrexian invasion and now regrowing.

entities.name: Doomskar
entities.description: The collapse of realms onto each other, causing earthquakes, destabilization and chaos.

entities.name: Einir
entities.description: The gods who once ruled the realms, defeated and replaced, who became the plane's elves.

entities.name: Skoti
entities.description: The pantheon that replaced the Einir.

entities.name: New Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: Invasion during which the ten realms collided.

entities.name: Harald
entities.description: Led the defense of the ten realms against the Phyrexians.

entities.name: Tyvar Kell
entities.description: Led the defense of the ten realms against the Phyrexians.

entities.name: Phyrexians
entities.description: Intruders on Kaldheim during the New Phyrexian Invasion.

entities.name: Skemfar
entities.description: Shadowed forest realm of elves who renewed their challenge against the Skoti.

entities.name: Axgard
entities.description: Realm of rugged peaks, home to dwarves.

entities.name: Bretagard
entities.description: Realm of humans.

entities.name: Gnottvold
entities.description: Forested realm of trolls.

entities.name: Immersturm
entities.description: Realm of fire, demons and constant warfare.

entities.name: Istfell
entities.description: Mist-shrouded realm at the base of the World Tree, home to spirits.

entities.name: Karfell
entities.description: Realm of the draugr.

entities.name: Littjara
entities.description: Realm of lakes, home of shapeshifters.

entities.name: Starnheim
entities.description: Realm of valkyries and fallen heroes that provides light.

entities.name: Surtland
entities.description: Snowy realm of fire and frost giants at war.

entities.name: Valla
entities.description: A plane that contained the Immersturm storm and split from the World Tree.

entities.name: Ramaz
entities.description: Ultimate antagonist set on Kaldheim in Duels of the Planeswalkers 2014.

entities.name: Koma
entities.description: A cosmic serpent monster.

events.summary: The Einir gods, who ruled the realms, are replaced by the Skoti pantheon and become the plane's elves.
events.quote: The defeated Einir became the plane's elves .

events.summary: In 4562 AR Kaldheim mobilizes against the growing New Phyrexian threat.
events.quote: In 4562 AR , the plane mobilized against the growing New Phyrexian threat.

events.summary: During the invasion the ten realms collide and Harald and Tyvar Kell lead the defense.
events.quote: the ten realms collided, connecting Kaldheim as one plane

events.summary: Kaldheim's denizens burn the World Tree to deny the Phyrexians access.
After the invasion Skemfar's elves renew their challenge against the Skoti.
events.quote: Skemfar's elves have renewed their challenge against the Skoti.

relations.quote: they were replaced by the Skoti , who became the new pantheon
Harald and Tyvar Kell led the defense of all ten realms of Kaldheim
